items.title: Upgrade MySQL 8.0 to 8.4: What Breaks and How to Check
items.description: MySQL 8.0 reached end of life in April 2026, which means no more security fixes from Oracle for the community edition. The supported target is MySQL 8.4, the current long-term support (LTS) release. The move is a direct in-place upgrade, but 8.4 removed a number of things that 8.0 still accepted.
